name: Text
description: Exact text work: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 hashes; Base64, URL and hex encoding; JSON formatting and checking; regular expression search and replace; case changes; line diffs and counts. Use when a text result must be exact rather than guessed.

functions.name: text_transform
functions.description: Exact text work. action is one of: md5, sha1, sha256, sha512 (hash in hex); base64_encode, base64_decode, url_encode, url_decode, hex_encode, hex_decode; json_format, json_minify, json_validate (keeps key order and numbers); case (changes input to the case in `case`); stats (characters, words, lines, bytes); diff (compares input with target, line by line); extract (every match of the regular expression in pattern); replace (replaces every match of pattern with replacement, where $1 or ${name} is a group).

pattern.description: For extract and replace: a regular expression

replacement.description: For replace: the text put in place of each match

case.description: For case: the case to change to

target.description: For diff: the text to compare with
